conditions: Rewards pay in A, A, B, C order: zones 2 and 4 are A, 6 is B, 8 is C, then it repeats.
Elite disables abilities spammed in quick succession, for 8 to 15 seconds. Cast a nuke about every 10 seconds rather than on cooldown.
Each zone transition strips buffs, resets energy and ammo, and costs frame-specific stacks.
Enemies and tilesets are fixed per week, so a bad week for your frame stays bad all week.
bonuses: Elite is also a Focus source, so parts fall out of Focus runs.

disclosures.title: frames that carry it
disclosures.body: Mirage with Explosive Legerdemain is the most named for the long passive grind; Saryn, Volt, Gara, Khora, Atlas, Voruna and Valkyr with Hysteria are also recommended. Atlas keeps melee combo up with Naramon.

disclosures.title: stopping early
disclosures.body: Rewards are granted before you jump into the conduit, so leaving after one is safe. Running to zone 6 (A, A, B) repeatedly is efficient if efficiency dies early, and if it hits zero before the next conduit you are extracted with what you earned.

disclosures.title: squads
disclosures.body: Public lobbies are mostly people levelling gear who leave after zone 2 or 3. Bring a build that can clear solo.

disclosures.title: Incarnon Genesis
disclosures.body: A separate optional item that upgrades the Vandal; it adds no Mastery.
